overall_structure.value: Austenite-based (FCC) Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel; XRD shows a dominantly single austenite (γ) phase with retained κ-carbide reflections. After 3 MAF passes the grains are refined and heavily subdivided by a dense low-angle boundary network (low-angle boundary fraction at its maximum) with a progressively randomized texture.

phase_evolution.value: No deformation twinning occurs in this alloy during MAF; the austenite is stable (no martensite formed). Annealing twin boundary fraction is very small. Texture is progressively randomized as the number of passes increases.

Dislocation density for MAF-3 is reported inconsistently: Table 1 gives 7.5 × 10^15 m^-2, whereas the Mechanical properties text states 7.8 × 10^15 m^-2 (about ten times that of the solutionized material).
Yield strength for MAF-3 is reported inconsistently: the Mechanical properties text gives 1279 MPa, while Table 2 lists measured YS = 1289 MPa for 3 Pass.
MAF-3 average grain size by EBSD = 20 μm (reduced from 50 μm at MAF-0 and 35 μm at MAF-1).
MAF-3 high-angle grain boundary fraction = 0.24; low-angle grain boundary fraction = ~0.75 (0.759), the maximum of the MAF series.
MAF-3 amount of work hardening = 126 MPa; UTS (1415 MPa) and YS diverge less than in earlier passes.
In this alloy there is no deformation twinning during MAF; the annealing twin boundary fraction is negligible (0.007 in MAF-1 and 0.003 in MAF-5).

FE simulation: after 3 passes the predicted yield strength agrees closely with the measured value (curves nearly converge between 1 and 3 passes); simulation underestimates YS most strongly at 5 passes.

FE simulation of specimen shape does not accurately replicate the experimental distortion, attributed to the absence of crystallographic texture effects in the simulation; the simulated strength is lower than the experimental value.
Simulated yield strength depends on depth from the surface of the forged sample: maximum at the centre and decreasing towards the surface (Fig. 14, SDV5 range ≈ +6.994e+02 to +1.358e+03).
